text:
marta: Quick sync — we're finalizing social cadence for the 'Benchmarking Inference Costs' webinar next Wed. Need confirmation on X vs LinkedIn threading, who owns the asset set, and the inbound lead capture -> SDR routing.

sanjay: I can own the X thread drafting and the hero post. ETA for copy by EOD tomorrow. :+1:

aj: I'll take the LinkedIn carousel + short-form copy. Can we keep two CTA variants? one to register, one to download benchmark cheat-sheet.

leo: SDR routing: does marketing want immediate lead push to the SDR queue or a 24h digest? we need to know to set the webhook on the form.

marta: Good q — prefer immediate push for webinar registrants, but for bench cheat-sheet downloads we can batch 6-12h. Need CRM webhook details from eng.

emily: Assets: I uploaded the slide deck preview + two hero images to /assets/marketing/webinar_0312. Also added a short 30s clip for X. Link: https://files.redwood.example/webinar0312

sanjay: For X thread plan — short opener, 3 data-backed blurbs from the benchmark, CTA to register, follow-up thread 1 hour after with a clip. Draft outline:
- Tweet 1: hook + stat
- Tweet 2: methodology note
- Tweet 3: headline results
- Tweet 4: CTA + link

aj: LinkedIn carousel idea: 5 cards — problem, methodology, 3 key findings, closing CTA. Keep text 1-2 lines per card.

marta: UTM/template we should use (please copy/paste into scheduler):
```
?utm_source=organic&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=benchmark_webinar_2026&utm_content={cta_variant}
```
Use cta_variant = register | cheat_sheet

leo: CRM webhook for immediate pushes: POST to https://crm.redwood.example/webhooks/marketer with payload {"email":"...","source":"webform","tags":["webinar-0312"]}
I left a note for eng to add HMAC header.

marketing-bot: Reminder: scheduled posts must be in the scheduler by 2026-03-10 23:59 PT to pass legal/compliance review.

aj: A/B test on first tweet copy? short vs curiosity. Also testing two thumbnails on LinkedIn: hero A vs clip frame.

sanjay: I like that. I'll draft both hooks, mark them as variant A/B in the spreadsheet and reference the UTM param.

marta: Who will monitor engagement and handle follow-ups post-live? We should have a 2-hour engagement squad: aj + leo for first hour, emily second hour.

leo: Confirmed. SDRs will get immediate push for registrants; I'll configure the webhook and add a 1-min debounce so we don't flood.

emily: For reply templates / follow-ups, here's two quick snippets you can reuse:
- "Thanks for registering! Here's your calendar link. Any topics you'd like covered?"
- "Love this question — we'll cover it live. Want the benchmarking notes early?"

sanjay: I'll schedule initial posts for Wed 10:00 PT (X) and 10:15 PT (LinkedIn). Follow thread at 11:00 PT with clip. Anyone object?

aj: Fine by me. I'll queue variants and thumbnails.

marta: Perfect. Action items: sanjay = X copy + schedule + A/B hooks; aj = LinkedIn carousel + thumbnails; emily = engagement snippets + monitor; leo = webhook + SDR routing; me = final copy review and compliance sign-off. Let's reconfirm at EOD.

marketing-bot: Action items logged to #campaigns with tag benchmark_webinar_0312.

marta: thanks team — short follow-up thread with open questions in an hour. :sparkles:
